title: The Children of random inspiration
description: Adds lots of tools with different themes (mostly dark souls) to your game when renamed
body:
# The children of random inspiration

## What are you getting in?
The resource pack is what the name suggests. It may seem that it's all dark souls, but that's because i mostly get inspired by the trilogy. There will be more original creations (maybe) and more creations from other series, be it game series or movies.

**The list** of new items is _inside_ of the pack, in a **README.txt** or in the **gallery** _here_ on **Modrinth**

## The items from Dark Souls Trilogy
![DS themed items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ecc4eccdf0da8d83175ed03f62997da3921bd7fa_0.webp)

## Requirements: 
**Nothing** is required for this resource pack, as Mojang has made this kind of a resource pack possible in vanilla. I would **recommend** computer that's stronger than a potato though, because most slopes were made of thousands of pieces (until recently with another change to the game).

For suggestions and bug reports i've set up [a GitHub page](https://github.com/XtonevV/Children-of-random-inspiration/discussions/categories/suggestion-box)
